game: The Urbz: Sims in the City
project: The Urbz: Sims in the City Recompiled
approach: Static recompilation of the retail XBE to C++; XDK HLE on a Direct3D 12 renderer with XAudio2 on Windows, and a Vulkan renderer with SDL3 on Linux
help: Naming the 108 unmatched XDK functions in config/game.toml (D3D8, DirectSound, crt math)
DirectSound exports still running guest code: Lock/Unlock, 0xB0080, 0xB00A3-0xB00A5, 0xB00A9
Play testing past the starting rooftop: other districts, jobs, minigames
Saving to a device and reloading
Host crt_sin/cos/tan/atan/sqrt/log so float results match the Xbox
notes: Boots from the retail USA XBE: 15,942 functions recompiled. Intro movies, title, menus, Create-an-Urb and the city load all run, and free-roam on the starting rooftop renders at ~60 fps (576-984 draws per frame) with walking, dialogue and socials. Fixed so far: a push-buffer render deadlock, vertex-shader constant packets, P8 palettes, the all-black gamma ramp, DirectSound PlayEx and Pause. Not yet exercised: saving to a device and reloading, districts past the starting rooftop, jobs and minigames. 108 of 238 XDK functions are still unmatched and trap if the game calls them.
